title: Shower Squeegee With Smooth Handle (Solid Brass) | Antique Copper | Squeegee Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop water spots and streaks before they dry on your shower door, tile, and mirrors in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. This shower squeegee removes moisture in quick, easy strokes and stores neatly on the included decorative wall hook.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Create a coordinated bathroom look with the distinctive Squeegee collection—an ideal match for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
  • Built for daily use with solid brass materials and a blade that can be easily replaced.

Specs

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 15 x 10 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 16 x 10 x 8 in.
  • Shipping weight: 4 lb
  • Mounting: wall-mounted hook included
  • multiple designer finish options available
